'''2020 TMW Pods Kendall Halman DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kendall Halman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Vile Halman DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
